# Yoranix — full site content map

> Yoranix is a digital solutions company based in Sydney, Australia, serving clients
> globally. Tagline: "Digital Solutions. Real Impact." Descriptor: end-to-end digital
> solutions for education and enterprises.

## What Yoranix does

Yoranix delivers complete digital infrastructure for learning and business — from
Moodle LMS deployments to cloud-native DevOps — as secure, scalable platforms with
managed support. Services are modular and can be combined into a tailored managed
service.

### 1. Complete Moodle Solution
Setup, theme, plugins, integrations, and training for seamless learning experiences.
Includes: implementation and theming; plugin governance, management, and performance
tuning; user training, documentation, onboarding, and adoption.

### 2. Server Hosting & Maintenance
VPS, backups, security hardening, and proactive monitoring to keep you online.
Includes: VPS/cloud hosting with redundancy; performance tuning; uptime monitoring
and patch management; regular security audits and backups; disaster recovery.

### 3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and auto-scaling tailored to your
workloads. Includes: Kubernetes and Docker; automation pipelines tuned to your
stack; infrastructure-as-code; observability, alerting, logging, and metrics.

### 4. Custom Integrations & Automation
APIs, SIS/CRM integrations, and automated reporting to streamline operations.
Includes: CRM and SIS connectors; reporting automation; single sign-on.

### Managed Support & Training
Ongoing support plans with SLAs; onboarding sessions and enablement; custom
workshops for teams and leaders.

## Why Yoranix

- End-to-end support: from planning to launch and ongoing care.
- Education-first expertise: specialists in LMS, digital learning, and integrations.
- Secure and scalable infrastructure: hardened environments, best-practice backups,
  observability baked in.
- Transparent reporting and monitoring: clear metrics, weekly updates, shared
  dashboards.

## Who Yoranix serves

- Colleges and training providers: robust LMS deployments, multi-campus support,
  accessible learning journeys.
- Enterprises and SMEs: secure hosting, compliance-ready architectures, integration
  with business apps.
- EdTech startups: cloud-native builds, rapid prototyping, observability.

## How engagement works

Request a service proposal or book a meeting via the website. Yoranix responds
within one business day, holds a discovery call to align on outcomes and timelines,
then provides a clear proposal with milestones, SLAs, and pricing.

## Pages

- Home (/) — overview, services, testimonials, FAQ
- Services (/services) — all four core services and delivery detail
- FAQ (/faq) — common questions answered plainly
- Request a Service (/request-service) — proposal request form
- Book a Meeting (/book-meeting) — Google Calendar scheduling
- Contact (/contact) — contact form and details
- Privacy (/privacy) — privacy notice
